novel_features.name: Latest news roll-up
novel_features.description: Fan out across Discover new-launches, Trending/Most-Funded, and Kickstarter Magazine editorial in one call — single ranked stream of fresh signal.

novel_features.name: Tech radar
novel_features.description: Newly launched Technology/Design projects ranked by funding velocity over a time window. Filter to AI/Hardware/Software/Robots subcategories.

novel_features.name: Funding-rank
novel_features.description: Rank live projects by funding velocity (% of goal raised per hour-since-launch) over a configurable window.

novel_features.name: Vertical mapping
novel_features.description: Score each project against a named vertical (ai-agents, frontier-ai, smb-saas, geopolitics, aus-tech, india-tech) using keyword + description + tag matching. Stored in vertical_match table for SQL composition.

novel_features.name: Magazine FTS search
novel_features.description: Full-text search over locally-mirrored Kickstarter Magazine articles (editorial posts from KS staff covering trends, creator spotlights, Maker Monday roll-ups).

novel_features.name: Category velocity
novel_features.description: Aggregate launches-per-day and total-pledged-per-day for each top-level category over a time window. Surfaces which categories are accelerating.

novel_features.name: Diff-since-last-sync
novel_features.description: Periodic sync emits only the delta (new + changed projects) since the last successful sync, as JSONL one-per-line.
